name: @noir-wallet/extension
description: Noir Wallet is a self-custodial crypto wallet designed to support privacy-preserving on-chain activity.

scripts.build: pnpm run type-check && vite build && node scripts/verify-build-surface.mjs
scripts.build:testnet: pnpm run type-check && NETWORK_MODE=testnet vite build && NETWORK_MODE=testnet node scripts/verify-build-surface.mjs
scripts.test:extension: PLAYWRIGHT_E2E=1 E2E_BUILD_PROFILE=mainnet-zcash-regression ENABLED_CHAIN_FEATURE_FLAGS= pnpm run build && E2E_BUILD_PROFILE=mainnet-zcash-regression ENABLED_CHAIN_FEATURE_FLAGS= playwright test --project=extension --workers=4
scripts.test:release:default: pnpm --filter @noir-wallet/sdk build && pnpm --filter @noir-wallet/example build && BUILD_CHANNEL=beta PLAYWRIGHT_E2E=1 E2E_BUILD_PROFILE=mainnet-release-default EVM_HISTORY_API_ORIGIN=https://evm-history.test RHEA_SWAP_ACCESS_TOKEN=test-rhea-access-token pnpm run build && E2E_SCREENSHOTS=1 E2E_BUILD_PROFILE=mainnet-release-default playwright test --project=release-default --workers=1
scripts.test:production-dist: BUILD_CHANNEL=production EVM_HISTORY_API_ORIGIN=https://evm-history.test RHEA_SWAP_ACCESS_TOKEN=test-rhea-access-token GA_API_SECRET=test-analytics-api-secret CUSTOM_ANALYTICS_PASSWORD=test-analytics-password pnpm run build && E2E_SCREENSHOTS=1 playwright test --project=production-dist --workers=1
scripts.test:evm:testnet: PLAYWRIGHT_E2E=1 NETWORK_MODE=testnet E2E_BUILD_PROFILE=testnet-evm ENABLED_CHAIN_FEATURE_FLAGS=chain.evm pnpm run build && NETWORK_MODE=testnet E2E_BUILD_PROFILE=testnet-evm ENABLED_CHAIN_FEATURE_FLAGS=chain.evm playwright test --project=evm-testnet
scripts.test:evm:testnet:live: PLAYWRIGHT_E2E=1 NETWORK_MODE=testnet E2E_BUILD_PROFILE=testnet-evm ENABLED_CHAIN_FEATURE_FLAGS=chain.evm pnpm run build && NETWORK_MODE=testnet E2E_BUILD_PROFILE=testnet-evm ENABLED_CHAIN_FEATURE_FLAGS=chain.evm playwright test --project=evm-testnet-live
scripts.test:multichain:receive:testnet: PLAYWRIGHT_E2E=1 NETWORK_MODE=testnet E2E_BUILD_PROFILE=testnet-multichain-receive ENABLED_CHAIN_FEATURE_FLAGS=chain.evm,chain.bitcoin,chain.solana,chain.near pnpm run build && NETWORK_MODE=testnet E2E_BUILD_PROFILE=testnet-multichain-receive ENABLED_CHAIN_FEATURE_FLAGS=chain.evm,chain.bitcoin,chain.solana,chain.near playwright test --project=multichain-receive-testnet
scripts.test:portfolio:solana-near:testnet: PLAYWRIGHT_E2E=1 NETWORK_MODE=testnet E2E_BUILD_PROFILE=testnet-solana-near-portfolio ENABLED_CHAIN_FEATURE_FLAGS=chain.solana,chain.near pnpm run build && NETWORK_MODE=testnet E2E_BUILD_PROFILE=testnet-solana-near-portfolio ENABLED_CHAIN_FEATURE_FLAGS=chain.solana,chain.near playwright test --project=solana-near-portfolio-testnet --workers=1
scripts.test:solana-near:testnet:live: PLAYWRIGHT_E2E=1 NETWORK_MODE=testnet E2E_BUILD_PROFILE=testnet-solana-near-live ENABLED_CHAIN_FEATURE_FLAGS=chain.solana,chain.near pnpm run build && APPROVAL_WINDOW_E2E=1 NETWORK_MODE=testnet E2E_BUILD_PROFILE=testnet-solana-near-live ENABLED_CHAIN_FEATURE_FLAGS=chain.solana,chain.near playwright test --project=solana-near-testnet-live --workers=1
scripts.test:private-key:testnet: PLAYWRIGHT_E2E=1 NETWORK_MODE=testnet E2E_BUILD_PROFILE=testnet-private-key ENABLED_CHAIN_FEATURE_FLAGS=chain.evm,chain.bitcoin,chain.solana,chain.near pnpm run build && NETWORK_MODE=testnet E2E_BUILD_PROFILE=testnet-private-key ENABLED_CHAIN_FEATURE_FLAGS=chain.evm,chain.bitcoin,chain.solana,chain.near playwright test --project=private-key-testnet --workers=1
